periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees from the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval configuration with a height-to-width ratio greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering creating a teardrop morphology below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Substantially flat U-shaped posterior edge along the mid-dorsal line.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 30% of the visible torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance across the cranial crown approximately equal to 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.
